basis: BLAZER-INTEGRATE workflow binding (Release-owned): the operator inputs that os-release.yml mode blazer-integrate chains through, in order: a re-hash of the tools and their dependencies, a re-hash of the signed app inputs, scripts/blazer-allocate.py reserve (a fresh collision-checked blazer build under the shared lock, whose reservation derives the new work and reconcile directories), scripts/blazer-reconcile-seed.py seed, scripts/blazer-candidate-bundle.py assemble, scripts/blazer_integration.py admit and render (Flavors) and the rendered host-reconcile.py apply, on the blazer-prep isolated work tree (sourceRootFrom) after git-meta. The Frankel receipt directory, lock and source root come by pointer from their committed sources; no build number or work directory is committed. EXPECTED identities, never observed current state, each re-verified at execution and refused on any mismatch: sourceRun 41554911849 and sourceInventory (Chief and Infra, re-hashed by seed); and every path and sha256 of appsDir, policy, inputDigests, aapt, apksigner and toolDependencies, taken byte for byte from the report of the original Infra binding-observe run named in observation (complete, shared lock held, no problems; the report file's own sha256 and the artifact ZIP sha256 recorded there). toolDependencies are what the apksigner wrapper executes (host-sdk-layout.py): its lib/apksigner.jar and the source root's prebuilts/jdk/jdk21 java, both read-only and only hashed. The read-only SDK tools may sit inside the production source root only below prebuilts/sdk/ (aapt) or at the exact JDK java path. A measurement is the state at observation time only; the run re-hashes every one before anything is allocated. Nothing here was read from or run on any host by Release.
